documents.text: from a species of plant in the nightshade family, "Nothocestrum latifolium". It stretched from Aiea Bay (part of Pearl Harbor) into the mountains to the north. At the end of the 19th century, a sugarcane plantation was opened in the district by the Honolulu Plantation Company. In July 1941, five months before the attack on Pearl Harbor, Commander Thomas C Latimore from the , vanished while walking in the hills above Aiea.
